note: What a server sends when a unit comes into what a side can see. It states everything a client needs to draw the unit at once, and carries whole messages of the same family for anything a layout of its own cannot say. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: itemCount
fields.note: How many items follow. A client reads this and the rest for a champion, a minion or another unit with a mind; for a turret, a map prop or a building it reads nothing at all.

fields.name: items

fields.name: view

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The number of this statement about the unit; a client takes a path or a point only where it is not behind the last one the unit took.

fields.name: movement
fields.note: Every point after the first.

fields.name: movementAtSpeed
fields.note: Where the unit is going, and how a server makes it travel. WaypointGroupAtSpeed carries the same shape.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Along one ground axis, in world units; the height is the ground's.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Along the other ground axis.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way it faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way it faces, along the other.
